name: Cake de Partie
notes: All 5 photos are the same printed menu board (food side) and its dessert/drinks companion board, photographed at three different times with slightly different prices (menu was updated between visits). Used the two clearest/most current-priced boards (1.jpg for food, 2.jpg for desserts) as the primary source and cross-checked against 3.jpg/4.jpg/5.jpg, which show the same items at older prices; merged rather than duplicated. Drink-only items (coffee, tea, soda) were skipped as non-dishes.
